findings.finding: Real Claude CLI failed with authentication category in both cases.
findings.limits: Error category observed; missing/expired credentials or account/model authorization not distinguished. No login, refresh or secret inspection performed.
findings.current_evidence: authentication_recovery: successful Claude proposals, contrasts and defenses in two read-only cases.

findings.finding: Synthetic fast Codex proposals failed semantic contracts: alternative ID, missing tests, recommendation not referencing an included alternative.
findings.correction: Native and local schemas now enforce ID pattern, nonempty text and acceptance tests. Cross-field reference validation remains mandatory; no automatic repair.
findings.limits: Latest fast-model followup failed the recommendation reference. Native JSON/schema validity alone is insufficient. Invalid values are not retained.

findings.finding: Real Codex source proposal detected L2 received plans could omit reviews.
findings.correction: Controller independently requires review from L2, before and after execution; regression test rejects plan without reviewers before QA or inference.
findings.limits: Source snapshot changed after this finding. Prior read-only proposal does not approve the patched source; new cross-provider review is still required.
